name: Uemura Eri
source:
The heroine from the previous installment, she’s Rumi’s senior at work and a trusted confidante.
Rumi admires her big-sisterly nature.
She’s pregnant and plans to leave the company to get married.
Things are obviously going well with her husband, Shingo… or are they?
Is she secretly seeing her husband’s younger brother as well?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01005551.html/]dlsite[/url]]
